```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
library(readr)
library(yaml)
library(htmltools)
source("R/utils_catalogue_ui.R")
source("R/utils_card_images.R")
catalogue <- read_csv("data/metadata/catalogue.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- editorial_dataset_metadata()
subjects <- lapply(catalogue$theme, catalogue_group, field = "subjects")
concepts <- lapply(catalogue$concepts, catalogue_group, field = "concepts")
levels <- lapply(catalogue$level_ids, catalogue_level)
cat('<section class="catalogue-page catalogue-editorial" data-resource-catalogue="donnees">',
    '<header><h1>Jeux de données</h1><p>Trouver des données par sujet, notion et niveau, puis choisir leur ordre d’affichage.</p></header>')
catalogue_controls('donnees', nrow(catalogue), catalogue_filter_definitions(
  unlist(subjects), unlist(concepts), unlist(levels)))
cat('<div class="dataset-grid" data-catalogue-results>')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(catalogue))) {
  row <- catalogue[i, ]; item <- metadata[[row$id]]
  href <- sub('[.]qmd$', '.html', row$fiche)
  image <- card_image_path(row$id)
  if (is.na(image)) image <- 'assets/cards/catalogue.png'
  image_style <- if (identical(item$card_image_fit, 'contain')) ' style="object-fit: contain"' else ''
  attrs <- catalogue_attributes(c(title=row$title, theme=paste(subjects[[i]],collapse='||'), level=paste(levels[[i]],collapse='||'),
    concept=paste(concepts[[i]],collapse='||'), 'date-added'=item$date_added, 'date-updated'=item$date_updated,
    search=paste(row$title,row$short_title,item$summary,row$theme,row$source_name,row$geography,
                 row$unit,row$concepts,row$search_aliases,row$license,row$contributor_name)))
  cat('<article class="dataset-card" data-catalogue-card', attrs, '>',
      '<a class="dataset-media" href="',catalogue_escape(href),'" aria-label="',catalogue_escape(row$title),'"><img src="',catalogue_escape(image),
      '" alt="" loading="lazy" width="640" height="360"',image_style,'></a><div class="dataset-card-body">',
      resource_type_badge('donnees'),
      '<h2><a href="',catalogue_escape(href),'">',catalogue_escape(row$title),'</a></h2>',
      '<p class="dataset-card-description">',catalogue_escape(item$summary),'</p>',
      '<p class="dataset-card-context">',catalogue_escape(row$geography),' · ',catalogue_escape(row$level),'</p>',
      '<p class="dataset-card-source">Source : ',catalogue_escape(paste(editorial_sources(item),collapse='; ')),'</p>',
      '<a class="dataset-action" href="',catalogue_escape(href),'">Consulter la fiche</a></div></article>',sep='')
}
cat('</div><p class="catalogue-empty" data-empty-catalogue hidden>Aucune fiche ne correspond aux filtres actuels.</p></section>')
```
